requirement: > `Find structural matches in available files. Read selected nodes separately.`
rationale:
The requirement fixes one structural fact. The `search_structure` MCP tool definition's description must be exactly "Find structural matches in available files. Read selected nodes separately."

The only implementation root is `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/project_sources.rs#impl[Session<'_, D>/ToolSession<D>]/fn[definitions]`. It builds a `json!` tool definition with `"name":"search_structure"`. Its `"description"` field is that exact string. The definition is then deserialized into `ToolDefinition` values and returned, so the description is part of the advertised tool.

A text search for the string found it only in this definition and in the requirement's own markdown. The other `search_structure` definition, in `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/sources.rs`, has a different description. That is a separate tool session, and the requirement does not cover it.

The task is a structural assessment, so I did not look for tests or other behavioral evidence. No gaps found, and there are no acknowledgments to account for.
